_comment: Machine-readable slide-layout vocabulary for the PLAN step. Topic-agnostic: it classifies the STRUCTURE of a beat's copy (a list, a progression, a contrast, a product drop...), never the subject. `render`=template -> engine/graphics_templates.py (deterministic). `render`=agentic -> the HTML is authored per docs/ART-DIRECTION.md (the advanced path). copy_char_budget is authored (never pixel-measured); the renderer does not auto-shrink.
_priority_note: When several triggers fire for one beat, pick the highest-priority match that the frame's allowed_layouts permits. `statement` always matches last as the universal catch-all.

cover.copy_function: Open the hook in <=8 words (title) + a one-line promise (subtitle) + eyebrow kicker.

cta.copy_function: One directive headline + one soft ask (the CTA). One ask only, varied from recent posts.

useful_drop.intent: A product / release / tool card: a specific named thing the audience can use today.
trigger_signals: a specific named tool/repo/product is the beat
useful_drop.copy_function: The name is the hero (headline). One line 'what it is'. A chip row: a class/category chip + an activity/metric chip. One line 'where it fits'.

stack_diagram.intent: A 'composes-with' story as a visual: a horizontal flow of token-styled tiles.
trigger_signals: a pipeline / composition of steps or tools
stack_diagram.copy_function: 3-6 short tile labels in order, joined by accent arrows. The flow IS the message; minimal surrounding words.

progression.intent: Show the same metric across ordered stages/time so the change is the point.
progression.copy_function: Staged rows, value -> value, so the delta reads at a glance.

steps.intent: An ordered / numbered sequence or process.

comparison.copy_function: Two panels; a tag + one line each. Keep the axis of contrast identical on both sides.

matrix.intent: Two crossed dimensions -> four cells (2x2 trade-off / positioning).
matrix.copy_function: Axis names + four short quadrant labels.

myth_reframe.intent: A wrong belief / common approach stated then corrected.
myth_reframe.copy_function: Myth row -> reality row. The reality line carries the one emphasis.

problem_solution.intent: An explicit pain -> fix movement in one beat.
trigger_signals: a named pain then its fix
problem_solution.copy_function: Problem block -> solution block; solution is the emphasis.

definition.intent: A concept is named and explained.

proportion.intent: A ratio / share is the point.
proportion.copy_function: Figure (the ratio) + a short proportion caption. Optional two-bar chart.

stat.intent: A single dominant number/metric carries the beat.
stat.copy_function: Big figure + a short caption for what it means. Add a real ECharts chart when there is series data.

quote.intent: An attributed line / testimonial is the beat.

list.intent: Several parallel, unordered points (no sequence, no ranking).

statement.intent: The universal fallback: one self-contained assertion / claim / takeaway.
trigger_signals: a single claim with no internal structure
statement.copy_function: 1 headline + 1-3 short supporting lines. <=1 accent highlight word.
